im2:t8caf3:1.text: Yes. Last summer, I planned to go to Busan with my friend. We booked train tickets and a guesthouse. But two days before the trip, my friend got sick. It was a bad cold. So we canceled everything. I got my money back for the train tickets. I was sad, but I stayed home and relaxed for a week. My friend bought me dinner later. Now I always check the cancellation rules first.
